instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Pull the messages from the Discord text channels my bot can read into my own records", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:pull-my-discord-messages and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Reads the text and announcement channels of every server the bot is in (only those the bot may view and read the history of), newest messages first, and keeps them in your records beside the ones already there: a message pulled twice is kept once, an edited message replaces the older copy, and a renamed channel takes its new title.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: account-snapshot-part (records:list, records:write).
